scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --log-level info
scripts.ensure:sidecar: test -f src-tauri/binaries/.build-id && grep -q ollama-only-v24 src-tauri/binaries/.build-id && test -f src-tauri/binaries/python-backend-$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/host: //p') || npm run build:sidecar
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev: npm run kill:backend && npm run db:migrate && npm run ensure:sidecar && tauri dev
scripts.build:sidecar: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && PIP_REQUIRE_HASHES=0 .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt pyinstaller && PIP_REQUIRE_HASHES=0 .venv/bin/python -m PyInstaller python-backend.spec && mkdir -p ../src-tauri/binaries && cp dist/python-backend ../src-tauri/binaries/python-backend-$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/host: //p') && chmod +x ../src-tauri/binaries/python-backend-$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/host: //p') && echo ollama-only-v24 > ../src-tauri/binaries/.build-id
scripts.build:all: npm run build:next && npm run build:sidecar && npm run tauri build
